goal: Reduce memory usage for transactions in memory and eliminate memory-amplification denial of service
Allow nodes to store more transactions safely in the mempool and orphan cache
agreement: Strong consensus on the approach and benefits, with all reviewer concerns resolved
Tested ACK after verifying serialization roundtrips and running chainstate reindex (l0rinc)
ACK after benchmarking mempool capacity and confirming reduced memory usage (instagibbs)
ACK after reviewing the updated diff and reduction in traversal calls (optout21)
Concept approval without stated reasons (w0xlt, xyzconstant, darosior, brunoerg)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because it cuts memory amplification from adversarial transactions held in memory
It reduces at-rest memory usage across mempool and orphan pools
It allows the mempool to fit roughly 13 to 15 percent more transactions

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it mitigates a worst-case node memory amplification denial-of-service vector
Worst-case memory drops from roughly 28 bytes per weight unit to 1.6 bytes per weight unit
This protects validation resource limits during block and transaction processing
